integrity: Exact line restrictions and Frobenius cycles proved symbolically; independent direct F25 line census performed. No third-party mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to smooth quartics with 16 F5-points. Classical geometric bitangent formula and previously published Sziklai extremal classification are prerequisites; historical arithmetic priority risk remains. Counts lines, not tangency-point degrees.
title: Frobenius splitting of bitangents on Sziklai-optimal plane quartics over \(\mathbb F_5\)
